description: OSV lists advisories with no CVE id yet for some components: no vulnerability Subject, Claim or worklist row records them. Read the full list in the match document (`matches`), read each advisory and decide. The same set on a later run is this item seen again; a changed set is a new item.

count.description: How many (advisory, component) pairs the match document lists.

matches.description: The OSV match document holding every pair, in its unkeyed list: read it with `cruxible get Capture:<digest>`.

sample.description: The first 20 pairs, by component then advisory: osv_id (read it at https://osv.dev/vulnerability/<osv_id>) and purl.

set_digest.description: The SHA-256 of the whole set of pairs: the item's identity.

name: security.osv-unkeyed
